findings.description: The join separator condition was inverted when the return moved into get_help_spec: it now uses `not any_prefix_is_slash`, so the separators are swapped relative to the original code.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a boolean flag such as `--shout/--no-shout` (no slash prefix, so any_prefix_is_slash is False) has two entries in rv. The original code joined them with " / " and the new code joins them with "; ", so help shows `--shout; --no-shout` instead of `--shout / --no-shout`. The same inversion affects every option whose prefixes are slash-based. Impact: the help output changes for common options, which is a user-visible regression in the rendered help text.
